additionalInformation: The item's attributes grants the following bonuses:
Dagon can be upgraded by purchasing the recipe again, up to 4 times.
Upgrading the item improves its stats and also Energy Burst.
The total gold cost for each level is 2850/4000/5150/6300/7450.
description: A lesser wand that grows in power the longer it is used, it brings magic to the fingertips of the user.
trivia: Dagon is the name of an ancient Mesopotamian god.
Nyx Assassin's cosmetic item, Nyx Assassin's Dagon, is based on Dagon.
tips: Powerful against enemies who rely on high armor, damage block and evasion to survive.
Dagon can be used to put Linken's Sphere on cooldown, and make it's wielder open and vulnerable to other single-targeted disables.
Dagon's spell lifesteal can be combined with Radiance to rapidly heal yourself, which is very good as Radiance deals magical damage to enemies around it.
recommendedFor: Ganking heroes can use Dagon for an additional burst of damage to help secure kills: Nature's Prophet, Nyx Assassin, Storm Spirit
Heroes that can reduce magic resistance: Skywrath Mage
Nukers that want additional burst damage: Lina, Lion, Queen of Pain, Techies, Rubick, Luna
Heroes who buy Radiance for spell lifesteal as Radiance deals magical damage to enemies around it: Naga Siren, Treant Protector, Necrophos, Alchemist

notes: Cast Range bonuses from Aether Lens and Dagon do not stack.
